stages.name: Dev-kit bench
stages.gate: idle current measured ≤ 18 µA; ring burst holds VBAT ≥ 2.2 V with the reservoir capacitor

stages.name: EVT-0 layout, fab, bring-up
stages.gate: all functions work on the bench; antenna matched in a printed enclosure

stages.name: Works-like / looks-like
stages.gate: printed enclosure seals IPX7 for 30 min; lid passes child-resistance check

stages.name: Tooling T1 + iterations
stages.gate: T1 parts within tolerance; O-ring compression 20–25 %

stages.name: DVT build (100 units)
stages.gate: drop, IP67, ESD and battery-life tests passed; pre-scan passed

stages.name: Radio certification and SIG listing
stages.gate: FCC, CE/RED and UKCA paperwork complete; Bluetooth SIG listing
